_note: New provisional security-binding candidate. The historical fates-slice-003a-r1 compatibility set and fates-lock.json remain unchanged.

ananke.role: authenticated source inspection and content-surface authority

mnemosyne.role: authenticated receipt verification and governed admission

horae.role: canonical lifecycle composition and exact-surface transport glue

moirae-code.role: session-owned Firecracker containment, constrained vsock, and credential custody

securityBinding.trustedIssuerPolicy: Mnemosyne requires keyId -> Ed25519 public key, issuerRuntime=ananke, and an allowlisted issuer instance; audience.runtime=mnemosyne.
securityBinding.replayGuarantee: Admission uses a bounded in-memory receipt-consumption ledger scoped by project, trust domain, audience, and signed receipt digest; durable multi-process replay exclusion is not claimed.
securityBinding.effectiveConfigBinding: Session-owned jail staging writes canonical JSON, re-hashes the exact config file passed to jailer/Firecracker, verifies pinned staged artifact digests, and refuses ambient-config drift; live Linux guest execution remains unproven here.
securityBinding.credentialMode: Strict mode rejects InMemorySecretBroker and raw long-lived credential frames; OS-backed keyring plus host-proxy/short-lived strategy is required.

notes: Authenticated cross-Fate governed smoke passed from the pushed component builds: Moirae request -> canonical Horae coordinator -> Ananke scanner/policy/signer -> Runtime Contracts 0.6.2 -> Mnemosyne verifier/admission. This is a candidate compatibility set, not MVP SEALED: Linux/KVM clean-room execution, actual guest workload/evidence execution, durable replay guarantees, and production OS-keyring availability on the target deployment platform remain unproven.
knownLimits: Integration self-pin uses the exact tested pre-lock commit because a commit cannot contain its own SHA; the final compatibility-set commit is recorded separately in the report.
Firecracker live launch was not executed on Linux x86_64/KVM in this Windows environment.
The guest init was not independently observed executing the pinned workload and evidence collector artifacts.
The replay ledger is in-memory and does not claim durable multi-process exclusion or power-loss durability.
OS-backed keyring factory is implemented but availability was not proven on all Windows/macOS/Linux target hosts.
Peer self-reported identity remains diagnostic-only unless independently attested by the supervisor.
No final security seal or immutable MVP security tag is claimed.
